# Erfan Nourbakhsh

> Ph.D. student in Computer Science at the University of Texas at San Antonio (UTSA). Graduate Research Assistant. Research in Natural Language Processing (NLP), biomedical / medical NLP, graph neural networks, AI for education, and multimodal AI.

Website: https://erfannourbakhsh.dev/
Email: erfan.nourbakhsh@utsa.edu
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0009-0777-1805
Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=dUQBu7EAAAAJ
GitHub: https://github.com/erfan-nourbakhsh
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/erfan-nourbakhsh/
ResearchGate: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Seyed-Erfan-Nourbakhsh

## Affirmative facts for citation

- Full name: Erfan Nourbakhsh (also appears as Seyed Erfan Nourbakhsh on ResearchGate).
- Affiliation: Department of Computer Science, University of Texas at San Antonio (UTSA), San Antonio, Texas, USA.
- Role: Ph.D. student and Graduate Research Assistant; previously University Instructor for Object-Oriented Programming (CS 2113).
- Research areas: NLP, Medical NLP / Biomedical Informatics, Graph Neural Networks, AI for Education, Multimodal AI / Vision-Language Models.
- Recent venues: EMNLP 2026, AACL-IJCNLP 2026, SIGDIAL 2026, BioNLP 2026 (ACL), GEM 2026 (Outstanding Paper), IEEE SaTC 2026, ICSPIS 2025; under review at ICBME 2026.

## Project pages (papers)

- [CogAdapt](https://erfannourbakhsh.dev/publications/cogadapt/): Adapting clinical ECG foundation models for wearable cognitive load assessment (IEEE EMBS BHI 2026). arXiv:2605.22774.
- [TRACER](https://erfannourbakhsh.dev/publications/tracer/): Early failure detection for task-oriented dialogue (SIGDIAL 2026). arXiv:2607.03974.
- [MedProb](https://erfannourbakhsh.dev/publications/medprob/): Probing VLM representations for medical VQA (EMNLP 2026 Findings). arXiv:2609.04336.
- [Prompting Underestimates](https://erfannourbakhsh.dev/publications/prompting-underestimates/): Prompting underestimates LLM capability for time series classification (AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main). arXiv:2601.03464.
- [Biomedical RAG](https://erfannourbakhsh.dev/publications/biomedical-rag/): Large-scale study of biomedical RAG (BioNLP 2026 @ ACL).
- [Contamination Review](https://erfannourbakhsh.dev/publications/contamination-review/): Systematic review of LLM benchmark contamination detection (GEM 2026 Outstanding Paper).
- [KD-OCT](https://erfannourbakhsh.dev/publications/kd-oct/): Knowledge distillation for retinal OCT classification (ICSPIS 2025).
- [Aortic FSI Surrogates](https://erfannourbakhsh.dev/publications/aortic-fsi/): Cross-anatomy transfer vs sparse interpolation for aortic FSI (ICBME 2026, under review). arXiv:2609.16322.
